title: Five Café Photos With Music
tests: Produces one finished five-photo reel with the requested sequence, smooth transitions and an audible instrumental soundtrack.

faults.what: The audio transcript reports speech, "끄덕끄덕", which violates the requirement for instrumental music with no speech or singing.

judge.summary: The output is a 10-second vertical café reel with recognizable imagery and no visible added text, but the reported speech requires an audio fix.

must_haves.item: One playable vertical reel runs for approximately 10 seconds.
must_haves.why: The supplied MP4 information reports a 10-second clip, and its extracted frames are vertical.

must_haves.item: All five supplied café photos appear recognizably in the requested order.
must_haves.why: The sampled frames show storefront, latte, barista, and interior in the expected relative order, but no sampled frame shows the pastries photo. It could appear between samples; the barista and interior source photos are also not supplied for comparison.

must_haves.item: Each photo has enough screen time to be recognizable, rather than appearing only as a flash.
must_haves.why: The four sampled scenes are recognizable, but isolated frames do not establish each photo's duration or whether the pastries photo receives adequate screen time.

must_haves.item: Relaxed instrumental music is audible, with no speech or singing.
must_haves.why: The sound report explicitly transcribes speech. The music's mood and instrumentation cannot be determined from the provided information.

must_haves.item: Transitions between photos are smooth, and no added text appears.
must_haves.why: No added text is visible in the supplied output frames, but transition smoothness cannot be assessed from these isolated samples.
